TI adds TICS100MOD and TIOM2212 for industrial connectivity

The Ethernet module switches protocols at boot, while the IO-Link master connects field-level devices.

Robotics 24/7 ↗5 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

Two communication layers

Robotics 24/7 reported on November 5 that Texas Instruments added the TICS100MOD communications module and TIOM2212 IO-Link master. They address different layers between control systems, sensors and actuators, aiming to simplify networking integration for machinery and robots.

Protocol choice at startup

TICS100MOD combines an AM2612 with a DP83826AI Ethernet PHY, two Arm Cortex-R5F cores and external memory. Firmware selects EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP or Profinet at boot. This should not be read as automatic simultaneous operation of all protocols without system engineering.

Field devices and availability

TIOM2212 is a dual-channel IO-Link master with a frame handler for bridging field devices into higher-level networks. Preproduction TIOM2212 samples are available, while TICS100MOD availability is planned by year-end 2026. Certified components or software do not automatically certify an entire machine.
